en.about.p1: Atelier Fazzy is an online group where Kuraputi and Towaly freely create and share their projects.
en.about.p2: We develop games, useful tools, and Minecraft Bedrock Edition addons, which are available for everyone to enjoy.
en.about.p3: We also have a YouTube channel, so be sure to subscribe and turn on notifications to stay updated with our latest content.
en.about.kuraputi.bio:
Mainly responsible for design, development, and testing.
Level 1 software engineer working at an IT company.
Loves Furry and Ramen.
en.about.towaly.bio:
Mainly responsible for requirements and testing.
Kuraputi's coworker.
Gets scary when playing games. (lol)
en.works.noresults: No works in this Category yet...
en.detail.install.addon:
Open the downloaded file (.mcaddon / .mcpack). Minecraft will start and import it automatically.
Open your world settings and enable the work under "Behavior Packs" or "Resource Packs".
Enter the world and play. Some works may require "Experiments" settings.
en.work.aflib-dx12.desc:
DirectX 12-based library.
Built specifically for game development.
en.work.phantom-changed.desc:
An UNDERTALE fan game.
Currently in development.
en.work.af-ui.desc:
An expansion pack that makes
addon effects more lavish.
en.work.ycc-very-easy.desc:
A flashy mob focused on visual effects.
Modest strength, maximum flair.
en.work.ycc-hard.desc:
Minimal effects, maximum strength.
Standing still is not an option!
en.work.ycc-very-hard.desc:
Looks like a mob, but isn't quite one.
We kind of regret making it.
en.work.ycw.desc:
A collaboration with Witherzilla.
Features a special system.
en.work.vheltar-ephonixm.desc:
Inspired by a "goddess of destruction."
Includes external features (limited release).
en.work.merge-illusion.desc:
A puzzle game for smartphones.
Merge pieces to cast magic.
en.work.af-unicoder.desc:
Encrypts JSON in a custom format.
Easy to use.
en.terms.intro: Please read the following before using any work distributed by Atelier Fazzy ("we"), such as addons, tools, and games. By downloading or using our works, you agree to these terms.
en.terms.s1.title: 1. No redistribution
en.terms.s1.body: You may not redistribute our works on other websites, social media, or distribution services. This also applies to modified versions. If you want to share our works, please link to this site or the work's page.
en.terms.s2.title: 2. No use of models
en.terms.s2.body: You may not extract the models included in our works to use them in other works or publish them as your own.
en.terms.s3.title: 3. Credit (appreciated)
en.terms.s3.body: When you introduce or use our works, we would appreciate it if you credited "Atelier Fazzy" with a link to this site (not required).
en.terms.s4.title: 4. Disclaimer
en.terms.s4.body: We are not responsible for any trouble or damage (such as corrupted data) caused by using our works. We recommend backing up important worlds before use.
en.terms.s5.title: 5. Changes to these terms
en.terms.s5.body: These terms may change without notice. Changes take effect when they are posted on this page.
